Title: No observable login throttling at 20 failed attempts per account in approximately 14 seconds
Steps to Reproduce: Open staging login in Chromium. Submit 20 sequential incorrect-password attempts for one nonexistent username, then 20 for TEST_USERNAME loaded from .env. Keep the same browser session and source IP. Do not use the real password for these attempts.
Expected Result: Configured brute-force protection should throttle or challenge repeated failures at its defined threshold; confirm the required threshold with the application owner.
Actual Result: Nonexistent account: 20 HTTP 401 responses in 13.81 seconds. Existing account: 20 HTTP 401 responses in 13.51 seconds. No HTTP 429, Retry-After/rate-limit headers, challenge, or lockout message. Final existing-account attempt completed in 125 ms. Some isolated requests took 1.5-2.1 seconds, but no sustained increasing delay was observed.
Status: Observed protection gap at tested volume; policy verification required
Limitations: This bounded test cannot prove rate limiting is entirely absent. A higher threshold, longer window, or silent backend protection may exist. Follow-up valid login does not rule out an earlier temporary lockout.

Title: Map-only GeoLink exposes vehicle details to anonymous visitors
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Home and GeoLinks. 2. Create a temporary link for one vehicle with Map only access. 3. Open the generated URL in a fresh unauthenticated browser context.
Expected Result: Map-only access restricts vehicle details as specified in Home explanation section 49.
Actual Result: The anonymous page displays the vehicle identifier RK19910, status, distance and last-data timestamp. Reproduced in the targeted rerun.
Limitations: The temporary test link was deleted in cleanup. The grey map in the screenshot was not separately diagnosed as a map defect.

Title: Partial and case-insensitive searches fail to find the Default group
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Home > Groups and verify Default is visible. 2. Search for Def. 3. Clear the search and search for dEFAULT. 4. Allow debounced search to settle.
Expected Result: Both partial and case-insensitive searches return the matching Default group.
Actual Result: Both searches return no group cards even though Default exists. Reproduced after adding the search-rendering wait.
Limitations: Confirmed for the Default group and these two search values; this does not establish that search fails for every group.

Title: Keyboard opening of KPI Settings leaves focus on the background page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Home. 2. Focus KPI Settings and press Enter. 3. Wait for the settings checkboxes to render. 4. Press Tab.
Expected Result: Keyboard opening provides predictable access to settings controls without traversing the background page.
Actual Result: Focus remains outside the settings panel after opening. Tab moves focus to the Fleet button behind it. Reproduced with an additional rendering delay.
Limitations: Confirmed in Chromium; cross-browser focus behavior was not tested.
